findings.title: Invalid or missing memory mode bypasses project validation
findings.root_cause: Project checks run only when mode equals the exact string project; the mode is neither required nor enum-validated.
findings.reproduction: In a disposable copy, neutralize the explanatory marker in PROJECT.md, add an unresolved marker to an active spec, set mode to bogus or remove mode, then run python ops/memory_health.py.
findings.evidence: Independent confirmation returned MEMORY HEALTH: PASSED and exit 0 for bogus and missing mode.
findings.remediation: Require mode and validate it against template|project before other checks.
findings.regression_test: Unknown and missing modes must exit nonzero with a structured diagnostic.

findings.title: Project mode rejects the constitution's placeholder documentation
findings.root_cause: The scanner uses raw substring matching and cannot distinguish a declared syntax example from an unresolved placeholder instance.
findings.reproduction: Change only memory.toml to mode project and run python ops/memory_health.py.
findings.evidence: Validator reported PROJECT.md: unresolved template placeholder because the invariant documents TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER[...].
findings.remediation: Define placeholders as structured declarations/instances or explicitly exclude escaped documentation examples.
findings.regression_test: Project mode accepts syntax documentation but rejects a concrete unresolved marker.

findings.title: Stale index targets are not detected
findings.root_cause: Validation iterates files that currently exist but never parses index rows and verifies their targets.
findings.reproduction: Delete docs/spec/seo.md in a disposable copy and run the validator.
findings.evidence: Two independent runs returned MEMORY HEALTH: PASSED and exit 0.
findings.remediation: Parse index rows and fail on missing or non-file targets.
findings.regression_test: Deleting any indexed active document must fail.

findings.title: Frontmatter values and shapes are not validated
findings.root_cause: Required fields are tested for truthiness rather than type and allowed-value contracts.
findings.reproduction: Set authority to banana and status to imaginary; scalar answers and duplicate keys are additional static false-pass paths.
findings.evidence: Independent disposable run passed invalid authority and status with exit 0.
findings.remediation: Implement an explicit metadata schema and reject duplicates, empty answers, and invalid enums.
findings.regression_test: Table-driven invalid metadata fixtures must fail.

findings.title: Index exactly-once invariant is not enforced
findings.root_cause: Coverage is a substring check instead of a parsed index-table cardinality check.
findings.reproduction: Append a duplicate docs/spec/seo.md table row and run the validator.
findings.evidence: Independent run returned MEMORY HEALTH: PASSED and exit 0.
findings.remediation: Parse canonical table rows and require exactly one active entry per document.
findings.regression_test: Duplicate, stale, prose-only, and missing rows each fail.

findings.title: Configured checks are neither executed nor reported
findings.root_cause: The validator reads only memory.toml mode and ignores the checks table.
findings.reproduction: Set checks.test to a command that exits 23, run memory health, then run the configured command directly.
findings.evidence: Memory health passed with exit 0 while the configured command exited 23.
findings.remediation: Execute configured commands safely or split memory health from an orchestrator that reports each check PASSED/FAILED/UNVERIFIED.
findings.regression_test: Passing, failing, empty, missing, and unavailable commands produce the specified status.

findings.title: Project placeholder scan omits plausible active paths
findings.root_cause: Only PROJECT.md and the hard-coded active_documents list are scanned.
findings.reproduction: After neutralizing the constitution syntax example, place a marker in README.md or src/README.md under project mode.
findings.evidence: Disposable tests returned MEMORY HEALTH: PASSED for README and reserved source markers.
findings.remediation: Define and implement an explicit path/extension scan contract with exclusions.
findings.regression_test: Parameterized paths verify every included and excluded location.

findings.title: Malformed configuration or encoding produces tracebacks
findings.root_cause: TOML and text reads have no error boundary.
findings.reproduction: Use malformed memory.toml or invalid UTF-8 in an active document, then run the CLI.
findings.evidence: Monte Carlo produced 34 crashes; all 19 malformed-TOML samples crashed and 24 of 32 invalid-UTF-8 samples crashed in mixed scenarios.
findings.remediation: Catch parse/read errors and return structured path-specific failures.
findings.regression_test: Malformed TOML, invalid UTF-8, missing files, and permission errors exit nonzero without traceback.

findings.title: Current unit tests cannot detect major validator regressions
findings.root_cause: Two tests cover only current-repository success and one ASCII normalization equivalence; module globals prevent fixture roots.
findings.reproduction: Inspect tests/memory/test_memory_health.py and compare it with confirmed mutations.
findings.evidence: Both tests passed while AV-001 through AV-008 remained reproducible.
findings.remediation: Inject repository roots and add negative, CLI, parser, Unicode, and mutation tests.
findings.regression_test: Each confirmed root cause receives a minimal failing-before-fix fixture.

findings.title: Future canonical data ownership is incomplete
findings.root_cause: Site ID, SocialAccount, page SEO metadata, and general LegalDocument domains are referenced without complete storage ownership mappings.
findings.reproduction: Cross-reference docs/spec/content-model.md, template-versioning.md, source-of-truth.md, and create-client-site.md.
findings.evidence: Site ID must be generated/stored/exposed but has no row in the source-of-truth table; multiple declared domains also lack rows.
findings.remediation: Complete the ownership matrix before runtime files are created.
findings.regression_test: Validate every declared domain/public-manifest field maps to exactly one owner.

findings.title: Unicode ownership normalization is unsafe for Spanish knowledge
findings.root_cause: Normalization retains only ASCII a-z and digits after case-folding.
findings.reproduction: Compare normalized Spanish questions with accents and non-ASCII-only questions.
findings.evidence: Static probe showed accented and unaccented forms can evade equivalence, while non-ASCII-only strings can collapse to an empty key.
findings.remediation: Use Unicode normalization and retain Unicode letters/numbers with an explicit accent policy.
findings.regression_test: Spanish accent, punctuation, composed/decomposed, and non-Latin cases.

findings.title: Private vulnerability reporting and recovery evidence are underspecified
findings.root_cause: Security and recovery documents name actions but not a concrete reporting channel, evidence owner/location, access prerequisite, or acknowledgement target.
findings.reproduction: Attempt to identify where an external reporter sends a private report and where a clean operator retrieves prior DNS/deploy state.
findings.evidence: Independent README and operator agents converged on the missing channel and recovery-state ambiguity.
findings.remediation: Add concrete channels and evidence-bearing operational checklists before public or production use.
findings.regression_test: Tabletop report and rollback drills with a clean operator identity.

findings.title: Canonical Git origin invariant is not machine-enforced
findings.root_cause: Repository identity is documented but no preflight verifies exact fetch/push remotes before future publication.
findings.reproduction: Add or alter a remote in a disposable clone; no current memory check inspects Git configuration.
findings.evidence: Static inspection shows no remote validation in ops/memory_health.py or configured checks.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit local publish/deploy preflight; avoid CI assumptions about local remote names.
findings.regression_test: Wrong fetch URL, push URL, extra remote, and missing origin are rejected by the publish preflight.
